name: Claude-BugHunter
description: A Claude Code skill bundle for bug hunting and external red-team work - 85 skills, 16 slash commands, 681 disclosed-report patterns curated across 24 core vulnerability classes, plus enterprise identity + infrastructure attack matrices.
one_liner: A pre-loaded checklist and playbook that an AI coding assistant uses to go hunting for security holes in websites and apps, the way a professional 'ethical hacker' would.
buyer: An independent bug bounty hunter who wants to triage many more targets per week without hiring a team.
business_use_cases: A solo bug bounty hunter runs it against a rotating list of public bounty programs to surface more valid, payable findings per week.
A small penetration-testing shop uses it as a first-pass scanner on client engagements, then has a human verify and write up the real report.
A security consultant sells a 'pre-pentest' triage package that uses the tool to scope how exposed a client looks before quoting a full paid engagement.

money_ideas.idea: Bug bounty payouts earned from findings the tool helps surface faster
A paid 'automated recon' add-on tier sold alongside a human-run pentest engagement

steal_this: Run it this weekend against your own side project or a willing friend's app, write up one real finding, and use that as the portfolio piece to pitch your first paid bug bounty or mini-audit gig.
